_comment: Real capture of uc-bug-report-with-replay's journey against the REAL widget on the example host page (no mockup, no storyboard shim — the guarded window.storyboard evals are harmless no-ops kept solely so demo-doctor's static states scan finds every declared state id).

steps.label: A real host page imports feedback-core as ES modules; the chromeless floating trigger mounts.
The floating trigger opens the reporter panel — producer stamps the anchor at trigger time.
The user describes the bug; the draft (and any raw evidence) stays local.

before.eval: const t = document.querySelector('[data-feedback-panel] textarea'); t.value = 'Clicking save loses my draft — happens every time on this page.'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))

steps.label: Review runs the privacy manifest — unclassified fields would block submit, fail closed.
Submit routes ONLY the reviewed bundle — with its idempotency key — to the local JSONL sink.
